方.mn: A plough turning at the end of a furrow — it points the way. The DIRECTION you turn.

w.t: I will think of a good method.
I will come home in the evening.
I do not know the direction.

w.e: one side; on the other hand
w.s: 一方の意見も聞きます。
w.t: I will listen to the other side's opinion too.

四.mn: A mouth (囗) with two legs hanging inside — four was too many strokes to draw, so they boxed it in.

w.s: 四人で食事をしました。
w.t: The four of us had a meal.

w.s: 四月に学校が始まります。

定.mn: Under a roof (宀) a foot comes to rest — you stop wandering and SETTLE the matter.

w.t: It is laid down by law.

w.s: 明日の予定を教えてください。

w.t: We decided it at the meeting.

今.mn: A roof over a single mark — this very moment, caught and held under cover.

w.s: 今度一緒に行きましょう。
今朝は六時に起きました。
w.t: I got up at six this morning.
I will go to bed early tonight.

回.mn: A box inside a box, spiralling inward — going round and round.

w.s: 今回はうまくいきました。

w.t: I count the number of times.

新.mn: An axe (斤) cutting a standing (立) tree (木) — freshly cut timber is NEW wood.

w.s: 新しい仕事を始めました。

w.t: I read the newspaper every morning.

w.s: 新年おめでとうございます。
最新の情報を調べます。
w.t: I look up the latest information.

w.s: 新幹線で大阪へ行きます。
w.t: I go to Osaka by bullet train.

場.mn: Earth (土) where the sun (日) beats down on open ground — a wide, flat PLACE.

w.s: 待ち合わせの場所を決めます。

w.t: The venue is near the station.

w.s: 父は工場で働いています。
w.t: My father works at a factory.

w.s: 広場で子どもが遊んでいます。
w.t: Children are playing in the square.

w.s: 駐車場に車を止めます。
w.t: I park the car in the car park.

金.mn: A roof over the earth with two nuggets buried underneath — metal in the ground. Gold, and so money.

w.s: 金曜日に会いましょう。
金の指輪を買いました。

員.mn: A mouth (口) above a shell of money (貝) — one more mouth on the payroll. A member of staff.

w.s: 駅員が案内してくれました。
w.t: The station staff showed me the way.

九.mn: A bent elbow — nine is one short of ten, so the arm is still crooked.

入.mn: An arrow-head pointing down into an opening — going IN. (Compare 人: 入 has the left stroke on top.)

w.s: かばんに本を入れます。
w.t: I put the book in my bag.

w.s: 名前を記入してください。

立.mn: A person standing on the ground line, feet planted apart.

w.t: I stand in front of the door.

w.e: to stand (sth) up; to make (a plan)

w.s: 国立の大学に行きました。
w.t: I went to a national university.

w.s: 相手の立場で考えます。
w.t: I think from the other person's position.

開.mn: Two hands lifting the bar off a gate (門) — swinging it OPEN.

w.s: この映画は来週公開です。
w.t: This film opens to the public next week.

手.mn: A hand with the fingers and wrist drawn in — the long hook is the arm.

w.s: 母に手紙を書きました。
w.t: I wrote a letter to my mother.

w.s: 切手をはってください。
w.t: Please put a stamp on it.

w.s: タクシーの運転手に聞きます。
市役所で手続きをします。
w.t: I do the paperwork at city hall.

米.mn: Grains of rice scattered off the stalk in all four directions.

w.t: I came from the United States.
Brown rice is good for you.

力.mn: A flexed arm with the muscle bulging — or a plough biting the earth. Raw STRENGTH.

w.t: I want to build up my stamina.

w.s: ご協力をお願いします。

w.t: There is not enough electric power.
I make an effort every day.

学.mn: A child (子) under a roof with knowledge sprinkled on top — a child at school.

w.s: 子どもは学校に行きました。
科学に興味があります。

問.mn: A mouth (口) at the gate (門) — knocking and ASKING to be let in.

w.t: We call the responsibility into question.
I want to continue my studies.

高.mn: A tall watchtower with a roof, a window, and a gate below — a HIGH building.

w.t: My son is a high-school student.

w.s: 今日は最高の天気です。

w.t: I look up the height of the mountain.

代.mn: A person (亻) taking someone else's stake (弋) — stepping in to REPLACE them.

w.s: 会社を代表して話します。
w.t: I speak on behalf of the company.

w.s: 現代の社会は複雑です。
学生時代の友だちです。
w.t: They are a friend from my student days.

明.mn: The sun (日) and the moon (月) side by side — the two brightest things there are.

w.s: この部屋は明るいです。
もう一度説明してください。

実.mn: Under a roof (宀), the harvest hangs heavy — the real FRUIT of the year. What is actually there.

w.s: 実は知りませんでした。

w.t: I will carry out the plan.

w.s: 実力を見せてください。
実際に見てみましょう。
w.t: Let's actually go and see it.

円.mn: A round enclosure with a line inside — a coin. Japan's money is literally "the round thing".

w.s: 円いテーブルを買いました。

w.t: The yen is strong right now.

決.mn: Water (氵) bursting through a dam — once the bank breaks the matter is SETTLED, no going back.

w.t: I made up my mind to go home.

子.mn: A baby in swaddling clothes, arms out, legs wrapped together.

w.s: 男の子が走っています。
女の子が笑っています。

w.t: My son is a university student.
I will go and see how things are.

動.mn: Something heavy (重) plus strength (力) — put your back into it and it MOVES.

w.s: 地域の活動に参加します。
w.t: I take part in local activities.

w.s: 机を動かしてください。

京.mn: A tall gate-tower standing over the city — the grandest building, in the CAPITAL.

w.t: Tokyo has a lot of people.

w.s: 京都のお寺を見ました。
w.t: I saw the temples of Kyoto.
I went up to Tokyo for work.

w.s: 東京都に住んでいます。
北京へ行ったことがあります。

全.mn: A king (王) under one roof (人) — everything he owns, the WHOLE lot, gathered in.

w.t: I do not understand at all.
Safety is the most important thing.
People come from all over the country.

目.mn: An eye stood on its end — the two lines inside are the pupil and lid.

w.s: 旅行の目的は何ですか。
w.t: What is the purpose of your trip?

w.s: みんなが注目しています。
目上の人に敬語を使います。
w.t: I use polite language with my seniors.

表.mn: A robe (衣) with the pattern showing on the OUTSIDE — the face it shows the world.

w.s: 紙の表に書いてください。
w.t: Please write on the front of the paper.

w.s: 気持ちを言葉で表します。
w.t: I express my feelings in words.
It is displayed on the screen.

通.mn: A road (⻌) running straight through — traffic PASSING along it.

w.t: The bus passes along the road.
I go to the hospital regularly.

w.s: 普通の生活がしたいです。

w.t: I commute to school by bicycle.

外.mn: Evening (夕) plus a fortune stick (卜) — telling fortunes after dark, out beyond the walls.

w.s: 日曜日以外は働きます。

w.t: We eat out at the weekend.

言.mn: A mouth (口) with sound waves rising out of it in lines — speech made visible.

w.s: もう一度言ってください。
やさしい言葉で話します。

w.t: It is the dialect of this region.
I spoke up at the meeting.

w.s: 三つの言語を話します。

理.mn: A jewel (王) being polished along the grain of the field (里) — following the natural LOGIC of the thing.

w.s: 理由を教えてください。
人の心理は難しいです。

調.mn: Words (言) going all the way round (周) a thing — checking it from every side.

w.t: I look it up in the dictionary.

w.s: 調査の結果が出ました。

体.mn: A person (亻) plus their root/origin (本) — the BODY is the base a person stands on.

w.s: 体を大切にしてください。
w.t: Please take care of your body.

w.s: 体育の授業が好きです。

化.mn: A person standing (亻) beside a person bent over (匕) — the same person, TRANSFORMED.

w.s: 日本の文化を学びます。
季節の変化を感じます。
w.t: I feel the change of the seasons.

w.s: きつねが人に化けます。
w.t: The fox transforms into a person.

w.s: 技術が進化しています。

田.mn: A paddy seen from above — a square field divided into four plots by its irrigation paths.

w.t: They let water into the rice field.

w.s: 田んぼが広がっています。

w.t: I am going back to the countryside.
The paddy fields go on and on.

w.s: 六月に田植えをします。
w.t: We plant the rice in June.

当.mn: A small (⺌) hand (⺕) reaching out and landing right on the mark — a direct HIT.

w.t: I make a boxed lunch every day.
At that time I was a student.

八.mn: Two strokes splitting apart — eight is the number that divides and divides again.

w.s: みかんが八つあります。
八月はとても暑いです。
八百屋で野菜を買います。
w.t: I buy vegetables at the greengrocer.
